title: Tiny, cute magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g transform='rotate(-35 50 50)'>
    <!-- handle -->
    <rect x='45' y='58' width='10' height='30' rx='4' fill='#c0722f'/>
    <rect x='47' y='62' width='3' height='22' rx='1.5' fill='#e0954f'/>
    <!-- lens rim -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='23' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='23' fill='none' stroke='#d9b64f' stroke-width='7'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='19.5' fill='none' stroke='#f2d97a' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- glass -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='17' fill='#bfe8f0'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='17' fill='#a8dcea' opacity='0.6'/>
    <!-- shine -->
    <ellipse cx='43' cy='31' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(-30 43 31)'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- sparkle outside -->
    <g fill='#f2d97a'>
      <path d='M78 20 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2z'/>
      <path d='M20 62 l1.5 3.5 3.5 1.5 -3.5 1.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 -3.5 -3.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5z'/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
